svg.title: Model A on real data: expected vs reported dengue cases, North Cotabato, Jul 19 – Nov 14, 2020. Week of Sep 6: reported 0, expected about 39 (90% range 21–60), flagged; all 5 swapped reports in this period were flagged. Real 2020 test: 32% of errors caught (best simple method 8%), 10% of normal weeks flagged (2%), 15% false region-wide alerts (earlier version 71%).
